Each provider call on a multi-locale proxy goes through `Faker.__getattr__`, which calls `_select_factory(attr)`. Inside `_select_factory`, the first step is always `_map_provider_method(method_name)`. Because the proxy was constructed from a locale-to-weight dict, `self._weights` is set, so when more than one locale supports the method, `_select_factory` takes the weighted branch and calls `_select_factory_distribution`, not `_select_factory_choice`. The test invokes three distinct provider methods—`first_name`, `last_name`, and `name`—so that same three-function sequence repeats once per method.
